integrity: The sharp formula, step extremizer, nonmonotonicity and limit are proved analytically; the rational nonmonotonicity witness is independently checkable in check.py. Pre-existing explicit filter weights are credited, not claimed as original.
scientific_limitations: Bilateral one-dimensional lattice, real bounded finite-variation sequences, squared second-difference penalty; no finite-sample or periodic boundary conclusions. Historical priority remains unverified independently.
title: Sharp variation gain and nonmonotone strength dependence of the bilateral Hodrick–Prescott smoother
